captions.gbp:
Know your price before you book. Advanced Medical Imaging posts its self-pay prices up front: MRI $295 and CT $295 without contrast ($395 with and without), ultrasound $195, screening 3D mammogram $199, DEXA bone density $75 and X-ray $50 per body part. Every price includes the board-certified radiologist's reading, with no reading or facility fees added later. Self-pay patients don't need a referral: our physician reviews your request the same day, appointments are often available the same day, and results are ready in 48 to 72 hours. HSA and FSA cards are accepted, and we give you an itemized receipt. Contrast and some multi-area exams are priced differently, so we confirm your exact price before you book. Prefer insurance? We accept most plans and verify your benefits for free; your plan usually needs your doctor's order. MRI in Seminole and at our St. Petersburg 3T MRI center; other exams in Seminole. Prices as of November 2026. Using Medicare or Medicaid? Ask us what applies.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

Before you call, have ready: the scan your doctor mentioned or the area that's bothering you; whether contrast was suggested; reports or CDs from past scans; your HSA or FSA card.
